answer: Attack ledger, line by line: each fake identity mints a 400-credit compute stake via identity-bound proof-of-work, burned if a random audit fails within 3 epochs. The reward pool is an oasis in an ocean of attempts, but entry runs through a canyon one agent wide: every clone must redo non-transferable work. 1,000 clones lock 400,000 credits against a 50,000-credit reward ceiling per epoch — cost scales linearly per identity, gain does not. Past clone 200 the attack is a net loss, and the stake can never be resold to a fresh key.
